data.name: Akifah
data.gender_notes: Akifah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'kaf-y-f' which means 'to be fragile, to be eternal, to be a garden'. The name Akifah reflects the paradoxical nature of life, embodying both fragility and eternal beauty. The name Akifah carries the meaning “Fragile, Eternal, Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Akifah usually hope their child will grow to embody fragile, eternal, garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is destined to bring light, beauty and eternal joy to the world. The name Akifah is a reminder that even the most fragile and delicate things in life possess a deep and profound spiritual significance.
data.etymology: Akifah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fragile, Eternal, Garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akifah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عكيفة
in_arabic.meaning: عكيفة تعني العابد أو المقيم في العبادة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عكيفة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ك-ف-ه' والذي يعني الإقامة في العبادة أو الخدمة. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن العابدين والمقيمين للصلاة. يعتبر اسم عكيفة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية وعبادية عميقة، ويستخدم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية لتسمية الفتيات اللاتي يتصفن بالتقوى والورع.

in_urdu.name: عکيفة

in_hindi.long_meaning: अकीफा नाम अरबी मूल 'क-फ-ह' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है उपासना करना या निवास करना। कुरआन में इसका उल्लेख उपासकों और प्रार्थना करने वालों के संदर्भ में किया गया है। अकीफा नाम इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में उन लड़कियों के नामकरण के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो पवित्रता और भक्ति की प्रतीक हैं।

in_english.name: Akifah
in_english.meaning: devoted worshipper or one who resides in worship
in_english.long_meaning: The name Akifah is derived from the Arabic root 'k-f-h', signifying one who engages in constant worship or resides in a state of devotion. Referenced in the Quran as one of the attributes of the righteous, Akifah embodies the qualities of piety, dedication, and spiritual commitment. Historically, the name has been used across various Islamic cultures to denote a female individual known for her religious devotion and spiritual practices.

data.cultural_impact: The name Akifah carries the rich heritage of the Arabic language and Islamic culture. In many Islamic communities, names are believed to reflect the essence of the child's soul, and to have a significant role in shaping their identity. Akifah's name embodies the delicate balance between strength and vulnerability, a fitting reminder of the resilience and beauty that lies within every individual.
data.spiritual_significance: Akifah's name also holds spiritual significance within the Islamic tradition. The word 'akif' means 'to keep awake, to be vigilant'. In Sufism, a mystical form of Islam, one of the essential practices is keeping awake spiritually and remaining alert to the presence of God. The name Akifah serves as a daily reminder to its bearer to stay connected to the divine, to remain steadfast and focused on their spiritual journey, and to maintain a sense of fragility and awe in the presence of the Almighty.
